slides.title: Fundamental Concepts
bullets: Energy exists in multiple identifiable forms.
Systems exchange heat and work with surroundings.
narration: Energy exists in multiple identifiable forms across the universe.
These distinct forms allow energy to transform and transfer.

slides.title: Energy Transfer Mechanisms
bullets: Heat flows from higher to lower temperature.
Work is force applied over a distance.
narration: Work occurs when force gets applied over a distance.
This mechanical action transfers energy between objects.

slides.title: Process Analysis
narration: The First law governs energy conservation in all processes.
This fundamental principle ensures energy remains constant.
